period: Belgian delivery period 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31 inclusive (calendar year 2025)
configuration: 1 MW / 4 h pumped-hydro storage with accepted efficiencies (eta_pump=0.84, eta_turbine=0.90), 1 MW grid import and export, 500 kW Belgium PV valued at day-ahead prices, balanced activation, and historical P50 capacity bids
interpretation: These cases are dedicated-market alternatives. Their revenues are not additive and do not represent simultaneous multi-market participation. The results are historical perfect-foresight simulations rather than forecasts.
